name: Tabkeep
description: Arc-style pinned section, recent-tab switcher and tab auto-grouping on Chrome's native tab bar.

mru-older.description: Switch to the previously used tab (hold the modifier to keep cycling)

mru-newer.description: Cycle recently used tabs in reverse

reset-to-home.description: Send the current pinned tab back to its pinned URL

toggle-pinned.description: Pin the current tab, or unpin it to just below the divider

remove-pinned.description: Close the current pinned tab for good
